name: luxurious-marble-bathroom-mirror
image_purpose: Create a four-look collection of polished adult mirror selfies in upscale bathrooms.

prompt.project_info: Four-scene photorealistic mirror-selfie collection adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Four clearly adult original women, each with distinct hair and styling: brunette with messy bun in an opaque white towel; red-haired woman in a green textured bathrobe; blonde woman with bangs in a pink terry robe; and blonde woman in a securely wrapped dark-blue towel. No celebrity likenesses.
prompt.composition_elements: Scene one classic luxury bathroom with marble, gold fixtures and chandelier; scene two patterned marble bathroom with plant and bathtub; scene three gold-framed mirror with marble backsplash and toiletries; scene four symmetrical grand marble bathroom with vanity and white tub. Use natural mirror-selfie poses and varied angles.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm soft bathroom light, clean reflections, polished upscale atmosphere, distinct but coherent neutral and jewel-tone palette.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical photorealistic smartphone mirror selfies, realistic reflection geometry, sharp fabric and marble detail, natural skin texture.

prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, loose towels, exposed chest, logos, text, watermark, distorted hands, duplicate subjects, broken reflections
